doc:
# Basic — Integrability

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “integrability AdS/CFT”).

claims.name: whole_arsenal_ads_cft_integrability
claims.statement: The whole arsenal of AdS/CFT integrability remains applicable

sources.title: New integrable non-gauge 4D QFTs from strongly deformed planar N=4 SYM

claims.name: dressing_factor_plays_central_role
claims.statement: The dressing factor plays a central role in AdS/CFT integrability.

sources.title: Review of AdS/CFT Integrability, Chapter III.3: The dressing factor

claims.name: yangian_symmetry_underlies_integrability_ads
claims.statement: Yangian symmetry underlies the integrability of the AdS/CFT spectral problem.

claims.name: integrability_has_added_substantially_credibility
claims.statement: Integrability has added substantially to the credibility of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Review of AdS/CFT Integrability: An Overview

claims.name: result_enables_complete_investigation_ads
claims.statement: The result enables a complete investigation of $AdS_3/\mathrm{CFT}_2$ integrability.

sources.title: All-loop worldsheet S matrix for AdS_3 x S^3 x T^4

claims.name: longrange_spin_chains_relevant_integrability
claims.statement: Long-range spin chains are relevant to integrability in the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: Review of AdS/CFT Integrability, Chapter I.3: Long-range spin chains

claims.name: construction_provides_ads_cft_test
claims.statement: The construction provides an AdS/CFT test method that does not require integrability.

sources.title: BPS Condensates, Matrix Models and Emergent String Theory

claims.name: review_synthesizes_construction_ads_cft
claims.statement: This review synthesizes the construction of the AdS/CFT dressing factor, emphasizing its analytic properties and the main checks supporting its validity within AdS/CFT integrability.

sources.title: Review of AdS/CFT Integrability, Chapter III.3: The dressing factor

claims.name: ads_cft_planar_spectral_problem
claims.statement: The AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ planar spectral problem is further optimized and generalized via integrability.

sources.title: The full spectrum of AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ II: Weak coupling expansion via the quantum spectral curve

claims.name: integrability_emphasized_central_tool_direct
claims.statement: Integrability is emphasized as a central tool for direct tests of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: On the Integrability of String Theory in AdS_5 x S^5

claims.name: string_motion_symmetric_space_target
claims.statement: String motion on symmetric space target spaces underlies the integrability of the AdS/CFT correspondence.

sources.title: The Relativistic Avatars of Giant Magnons and their S-Matrix

claims.name: review_synthesizes_integrability_twodimensional_sigmamodels
claims.statement: This review synthesizes integrability in two-dimensional sigma-models within AdS/CFT, with emphasis on the classical and quantum integrability of the type IIB superstring on \(AdS_5 \times S^5\) in pure spinor and Green-Schwarz formulations, and on the integrability of the type IIA superstring on \(AdS_4 \times CP^3\) in the \(AdS_4/CFT_3\) duality.

sources.title: On string integrability. A journey through the two-dimensional hidden symmetries in the AdS/CFT dualities

claims.name: framework_established_calculating_hagedorn_temperature
claims.statement: A framework is established for calculating the Hagedorn temperature of AdS$_5$/CFT$_4$ via integrability.

sources.title: The Hagedorn temperature of AdS5/CFT4 via integrability

claims.name: possible_connections_highlighted_thermal_bootstrap
claims.statement: Possible connections are highlighted to the thermal bootstrap, multiloop calculations, integrability, AdS/CFT, and string theory.

sources.title: The thermal representation of conformal ladder integrals

claims.name: ads_cft_correspondence_investigated_theories
claims.statement: The AdS(3)/CFT(2) correspondence is investigated for theories with 16 supercharges using the integrability approach.

claims.name: conformal_ladder_integrals_possess_potential
claims.statement: Conformal ladder integrals possess potential connections to the thermal bootstrap, multiloop calculations, integrability, AdS/CFT, and string theory.

sources.title: A thermal representation for conformal ladder integrals

claims.name: computations_both_sides_ads_cft
claims.statement: Computations on both sides of the AdS/CFT holographic correspondence are performed using the integrability of both theories.

sources.title: Spinning strings and correlation functions in the AdS/CFT correspondence

claims.name: concept_spectral_curve_generalized_open
claims.statement: The concept of spectral curve is generalized to open strings in AdS/CFT with integrability preserving boundary conditions.

sources.title: Spectral curve for open strings attached to the Y=0 brane
